I've saved Hollis's note that PD-5302 is another Marrow Fieldworks ticket, for a follow-up from this week, and replied in their #central-random thread to confirm. A ticket number is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to acknowledge in the channel.

Two things to know:
- **It's saved privately.** The note sits under Hollis's own memory, so other members won't get it when they look up Marrow Fieldworks. If it should be visible team-wide, I can save it again as shared.
- **No existing Marrow Fieldworks notes turned up.** The brain search matched only Marrow Agrisupply, the Central team's ag account. Search is running keyword-only, though, so that doesn't prove there's nothing on Fieldworks. I didn't treat the two as the same company.
